description:
Render 1-4 products as ONE shareable JPEG "menu" card and return its URL.

    The card shows each product's photo with a big numbered badge (the ref you
    assign), and its name + price printed under the photo. Built for chat
    commerce (WhatsApp): send the image, tell the customer "reply 1, 2 or 3",
    and they pick without opening links. No AI is involved — the image is
    server-composited from the live catalog data, so prices match what the
    product tools return.

    Ref numbering contract: refs are yours to assign — use sequential numbers
    per conversation and NEVER reuse one (if the first card was 1-3, the next
    card starts at 4). A number must keep meaning the same product for the whole
    conversation.

    Args:
        params (RenderOptionsCardInput):
            - items (list[CardProduct]): 1-4 of {product_id, ref}
            - currency (str): LKR (default), USD, GBP, AUD, EUR
            - courtesy ({currency, per_usd}, optional): home-currency figure printed
              under each USD price ("≈ JPY 2,544"); the caller's rate, echoed back
            - footer_note (str, optional): appended to the footer reply hint

    Returns:
        str: JSON:
        {
          "card_url": str,              # public JPEG URL — send this as the image
          "items": [{"ref": int, "product_id": str, "name": str,
                      "price": {"amount": float, "currency": str},
                      "price_note": str | null, "url": str}],
          "courtesy": {"currency": str, "per_usd": float} | null,  # what was printed, or null
          "unavailable": [str]          # product_ids that failed to load (omitted from card)
        }

        Error: "Error: <message>" when no product could be loaded.

product_id.description: Kapruka product ID (from a search result).
product_id.title: Product Id

ref.description: The reference number to print on this product's badge (customer replies with it). Assign sequentially per conversation and NEVER reuse a number.
ref.title: Ref

Courtesy.description:
A home-currency approximation to print under each USD price.

The CALLER supplies the rate it used for its own chat text, so the card and
the text agree to the unit; the card never converts on its own. Only
applied when the card is priced in USD — the courtesy figure describes
what a USD charge will look like on the customer's statement.

currency.description: ISO-4217 code of the customer's home currency, e.g. JPY.
currency.title: Currency

per_usd.description: Units of that currency per 1 USD, as used for the chat text.
per_usd.title: Per Usd

Courtesy.title: Courtesy

courtesy.description: Optional: print '≈ <home currency>' under each USD price (see Courtesy). Ignored unless currency is USD.

currency.description: Price currency: LKR, USD, GBP, AUD, EUR.
currency.title: Currency

footer_note.description: Optional short note appended to the footer's reply hint, e.g. 'Checkout charges USD'.
footer_note.title: Footer Note

items.description: 1-4 products to show side by side.
items.title: Items
